intent: The i3blocks shutdown and gaming_budget blocks render from the daily-limits cache ($XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/daily-limits.json), so the earner list, sizes and ceiling come from the earned_time registry instead of being duplicated in shell; left-click opens daily-limits --gui.
scope: Non-goal: changing the shutdown enforcement itself (screen-locker / digital-wellbeing)
changes: gaming_budget.sh: drop the curl to the enforcer /api/budget, the config.json read and the fallback bonus sizes; read gaming budget/used/day and the not-done earners from the cache
shutdown_countdown.sh: replace earner_hint() with render_limits/load_limits fed by todo[]; →max from shutdown_after reaching the ceiling; unknown earners shown with '?'
Both: a cache older than 180 s (or from the future) shows a ⏱? marker and never stale numbers; jq runs only when the cache mtime changes (rendered line cached in $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR)
Tests rewritten from the curl stub to DAILY_LIMITS_CACHE fixtures; the shutdown exec bound drops from 2 to 1
